proposal.observation: NA-E023 (two-sided prefix-drift, dropout-free, rho 0.5): MAPE 0.1019 (parent 0.0999); short prefixes improved (1-10 MAPE 0.122 -> 0.095, 1-10 drift 0.086 -> 0.032, -63%), but the full-prefix view also received drift gradient: 51-75 MAPE +0.014, 76-100 +0.010, 76-100 drift +60% (0.014 -> 0.022); total drift only -14%. DISCARD.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: The registered one-way drift (loss.md §4.7: lambda * mean|f(x_trunc) - sg[f(x)]|, only the shorter view moves toward the full-prefix prediction) keeps the short-prefix gain of NA-E023 while leaving long-prefix predictions untouched, so total held-out drift falls >= 50% without hurting MAPE.
proposal.question_inherited: Can the drift gain at short prefixes be kept without moving the better-informed long-prefix predictions?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Long-view damage of the two-sided term.
proposal.why_this_experiment: A2 follow-up 1/3 of the prefix-drift direction (independent reviewer: promising — 1-10 MAPE -0.027, 1-10 drift -63%). Uses the already registered loss.md §4.7 variant prefix_drift + physics_anchor_gradient='stop'; lambda calibration now uses the same one-way form.
proposal.modification: As NA-E023 but physics_anchor_gradient='stop': L = lambda * mean|f(x_trunc) - sg[f(x)]|, both views dropout-free, rho 0.5; lambda calibrated on the one-way form (fix in the calibration path).
proposal.held_constant_components: NA-E009 model and config, split 2021, seed 2021, Relative Huber 0.15, Adam 5e-5, batch 128, max 100 / min 5 epochs, patience 5, checkpoint rule, data, masks.
proposal.controlled_variables: Split 2021 and training seed 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: Split-2021 MAPE/RMSE/Acc@15 vs NA-E009 (0.0999 / 22.5 / 0.743); prefix-band MAPE (esp. 1-10); held-out relative drift (eval mode, same truncation RNG) vs parent 0.026; balance band R median in [0.05, 2.0], active fraction, cosine.
proposal.rejection_condition: DISCARD if split-2021 MAPE > 0.1049, or BALANCE_FAIL, or the held-out relative drift does not fall by >= 50% vs NA-E009 (0.026), or the 76-100 prefix-band MAPE regresses by > 0.01 vs NA-E009 (0.1085). Drift metric = tools/posthoc_drift.py on best_checkpoint (eval mode, Generator seed 0, |f(x)-f(x_trunc)|*scale/raw_eol), not the in-run diagnostic. Otherwise confirm on 42/2024 and judge the 3-split mean.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; NaFadeNet block gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain, and EOL errors; domain guardrail flags; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, and throughput.
